summary: Laptop workstation trackpad bulging and battery swelling
description: The bottom shell of my laptop workstation has warped and the trackpad is physically jammed upwards. I have unplugged the charger and shut down the machine for safety.

summary: Single Sign-On authentication assertion failed for enterprise financial ledger
description: When attempting to log in to the enterprise resource planning portal via single sign-on, the browser displays a SAML assertion signature verification failure. Three accountants on the quarter-end audit team are locked out.

summary: VPN client drops tunnel every 5 minutes on corporate network
description: While working from the sales office, my virtual private network connection disconnects repeatedly with message 'Gateway unresponsive'. Standard network access works outside the VPN.

summary: Cloud database cluster connection pool exhausted
description: Microservices are throwing 500 errors across the application funnel due to maximum connection limits exceeded on the primary cloud database cluster.

summary: Payroll portal export timeout on large spreadsheets
description: When exporting the global payroll register with over 3,000 employees, the payroll portal times out after 60 seconds with an HTTP 504 gateway error.
